title: Planning reads a goal clause that names a class of files against every member, not only the file the notes name
goal: precheck lists, for a committed item whose goal clause names a class of files (_tools code, every article, every ledger), the members its touches leave out, so a clause such as SP-e4fm2ovk's 'a content item adds or removes a line that _tools code cites by number without check.py failing' is planned against all citing files (bench_core.py and kbfacts.py), not met for one and found unmet at the review (BG-3ewsdo6l filed in the sprint after the review)

run:
import os, sys, subprocess, tempfile, re
d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", d], check=True)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, "_tools"))
for n in ("a", "b", "c"):
    open(os.path.join(d, "_tools", n + ".py"), "w").write("# see kb/public/x.md:12\n" if n != "c" else "x = 1\n")
os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, "kb", "public"))
open(os.path.join(d, "kb", "public", "x.md"), "w").write("x\n")
def bl(*a):
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "_tools/backlog.py", "--root", d, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return r.returncode, (r.stdout + r.stderr).strip()
sid = re.findall(r"SP-[a-z2-7]{8}", bl("new", "sprint", "--title", "planted sprint", "--goal", "planted")[1])[0]
goal = "a content item removes a line that _tools code cites by number without check.py failing"
chk = "python3 -c \"import os; assert os.path.isfile(chr(97))\""
bl("new", "story", "--title", "citing lines", "--goal", goal, "--check", chk, "--touch", "_tools/a.py", "--sprint", sid)
g = ["git", "-C", d, "-c", "user.name=t", "-c", "user.email=t@example.com"]
subprocess.run(g + ["add", "-A"], check=True)
subprocess.run(g + ["commit", "-q", "-m", "init"], check=True)
rc, out = bl("precheck", sid)
ok = "_tools/b.py" in out
print("precheck lists the citing file the touches leave out:", ok)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Filed at the SP-e4fm2ovk close (retrospective). No suite test covers precheck yet: the planner of this story names the test file it extends before the start.
